actual_independent_commands.scope: Final planner, storage and local bare-Git recovery tests

actual_independent_commands.command: Read frozen SOURCE_FILES tuple from commit 0c37b30060c2dffb20226bd3efbedc65a75d04e3; compare each current file byte-for-byte with that Git object.

found_and_fixed.fix_reviewed: Both release asset years are cross-checked against the complete CSV table season before eligibility or selection, including empty/all-excluded plans.
found_and_fixed.issue: Asset-year/table-season binding was skipped when no event was selected.
found_and_fixed.reproduction: Optimized synthetic replay accepted 2027 CSV tables authenticated by release originals naming 2030 assets, returning NO_ELIGIBLE_EVENTS.

found_and_fixed.fix_reviewed: Live paths retain distinct start and completion clocks, record actual completion after source/normalizer validation, reject completion/final admission outside the original window, and preserve exact original clocks during readonly replay.
found_and_fixed.issue: Entry clocks could falsely certify timely planning or input validation after actual completion missed the deadline.
found_and_fixed.reproduction: Optimized delayed-normalizer fixture started at T90 minus one second and completed at T90 plus one second but previously returned a valid candidate retaining the earlier validated_at.

limitations: Synthetic correctness and local Git recovery do not establish hosted operation, source availability, genuine issuance, predictive accuracy, publication or deployment.
The planning pool reserves no future forecast/outcome capacity and grants no operational source collection or issuance authority.
Required full integration checks are owned and reported separately by the integration owner; this report does not claim those executions as independent verifier commands.
independent_review.review_state: Working candidate; exact reviewed file bytes recorded below. Integration-owner commit/checkpoint remains separate.
validated_semantics: Complete UTC-date inventory, deterministic first two eligible events, and two lowest numeric active roster player IDs per team.
All planning and fresh-input candidate contracts retain NONE_PLANNING_ONLY authority; old daily-v1 normalization is an internal DEVELOPMENT_ONLY codec.
Exact original CSV and publisher JSON hashes, asset identities and observation clocks are replayed; source ages are not refreshed during recovery.
Parent history is authenticated through its exact original ledger reference rather than trusted from a hash label alone.
Create-only receipts and logical identities preserve originals across retries and interruptions; unknown generic bodies or hidden forecast contracts reject.
Interrupted receipt files count toward the shared pool. Actual older namespace growth is charged conservatively alongside the protected first-cycle reservation.
Fresh local bare-Git push/fetch/detach recovery uses an independent object database without alternates and reproduces original parent/source/plan bytes.

limitations: No v2 issuer, scheduled authority, remote checkpoint adapter or publication admission is implemented by this foundation.
Local bare-Git recovery of invented fixtures is not authenticated remote source archival or actual operational timing.
A pre-write receipt timestamp is not local persistence completion; recovered planning records have no prospective admission.
The 2-MiB planning pool cannot reserve expanded forecast/outcome/grade obligations.
The original approved first cycle still requires actual owner dispatch during its original future start window.
